His frustration stems from the perceived danger of the situation and the futility of his warnings, which is more intense than his mere condescension. I should have assigned a higher score to Frustrated (e.g., 8 or 9) to reflect the urgency and stress in his dialogue, while keeping Condescending high (8 or 9) to capture his patronizing delivery. The next step is to balance the scores so that Frustrated is not lower than Condescending, acknowledging that his anger is fueled by the high stakes of the scenario.
